user.title: Add a 3D Home panel
user.description: 3D Home adds a page to the sidebar with a live 3D view of your home: a 3D scan you film with your phone, or a floor plan you draw.

data_description.url_path: The address the page opens at, for example 3d-home for /3d-home.

error.invalid_url_path: Use lowercase letters, digits, - and _ only.
error.url_path_taken: Another page already uses this address.

abort.already_configured: A 3D Home panel already uses this address.

data_description.builder_url: Where photos are turned into 3D scans: the 3D Home Scan Builder add-on shows its address on its page, for example http://192.168.1.10:8099. Leave empty if you only upload ready-made scans.
data_description.builder_token: Only if you gave the scan builder a key.

error.invalid_builder_url: Start the address with http:// or https://.
